Copying the wider team - We are ready to begin substrate preparation ahead of the floor covering installation. This supersedes the earlier version.

Body:

I will follow up next week if I do not hear back.

References:   
Body:  
Closing the loop on this: We are ready to begin substrate preparation ahead of the floor covering installation. Shot blasting is scheduled first, then patching at the two low areas the surveyor flagged, then in-situ probe testing per ASTM F2170 before any adhesive goes down. We will forward the probe readings and the manufacturer sign off before anything is set, and we will hold the sequence if the readings come back outside the specified range. Please confirm receipt.

From: Corwin Adebayo <cadebayo@brackenhillmfg.com>  
Subject: Willowmere Charter Middle School - Substrate Preparation Sequence Ahead of Floor Coverings  
Date: March 18, 2015, 11:44  
References:   
Body:  
Circulating for visibility: We are ready to begin substrate preparation ahead of the floor covering installation. Shot blasting is scheduled first, then patching at the two low areas the surveyor flagged, then in-situ probe testing per ASTM F2170 before any adhesive goes down. We will forward the probe readings and the manufacturer sign off before anything is set, and we will hold the sequence if the readings come back outside the specified range. Reply here if you need the source files.

Body:  
Ahead of this week's meeting: We are ready to begin substrate preparation ahead of the floor covering installation. Shot blasting is scheduled first, then patching at the two low areas the surveyor flagged, then in-situ probe testing per ASTM F2170 before any adhesive goes down. We will forward the probe readings and the manufacturer sign off before anything is set, and we will hold the sequence if the readings come back outside the specified range. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Reply here if you need the source files.
